text: A design review of every Launimator window is ready to read on this card: what each window is for, what looks wrong today (with numbered callouts drawn on real screenshots), which rule each point breaks, and a concrete fix with an effort size. The headline proposal is to retire the standalone Sprite Catalog window (the 'weird' sprite grabber) and let the Laumination Builder's better slicer do that job, plus a short list of fixes that would make the Builder itself stop looking broken.
details:
How to use this: open LAUNIMATOR-UI-DESIGN-SUGGESTIONS.md from the attachments; section 1 is a one-page ranked table, section 4 is the sprite-grabber proposal in one paragraph, section 3 walks each window with the numbered screenshots (annot-*.png).
Nothing was changed in the project: no code edits, no asset edits. A throwaway Sprite Catalog asset was created for one screenshot and deleted again.
Not yet verified: no real mouse gestures were performed (marquee, drag-to-reorder, painting were driven through the windows' own functions), so the feel of the gestures themselves is not assessed. Two small popups (the name prompt and the Recent sheets list) were described from code, not photographed, because one of them is modal.
Top findings you can see in the screenshots: a sprite drawn OUTSIDE its preview box across other controls (three screenshots, two different sheets); the Save button being the last thing at the bottom of a scroll that is 1.5x taller than the window; and the Sprite Catalog showing 17 empty thumbnail squares and a 'Tags' heading over its Sheet field.
technicalDetails:
Windows covered: LauminationBuilderWindow (+Browser/Zones/AutoSlice partials, NamePromptWindow, RecentSheetsPopup), SpriteCatalogWindow (ZuiAssetWindow<SpriteCatalog>), LauminaryBrowserWindow, AnimationAsepriteWindow - all under D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\Launimator\.
Capture recipe: EditorWindow.GetWindow(...) floating, titleContent set to a unique tag (T67Builder etc.), then D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\.agenthq\workspace\T-0067\mkshot.py writes shot-<TAG>.cs from the T-0081 PrintWindow template and mcp__unity-mcp__eval_file runs it. Captures are 225% DPI (3385x2359 for a 1500x1000 window); view-*.png are half-size; annotate.py draws callouts in view-space.
Populated data: ProtoGuy lauminary D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Launimator\Lauminaries\ProtoGuy_25cf2dfd\ProtoGuy.asset, animation UpperAimRotation (16 frames, 2 meta layers incl. a Vector layer) via LauminationBuilderWindow.OpenForEdit; cold walk used Assets/SpriteSheets/Saint Dragon.png through LoadSheet/AddRegion/SelectSingle/AddSelectedToSequence by reflection; the catalog screenshot used a temporary Assets/Temp/T-0067/T67Catalog.asset over the Hero sheet (deleted; git status clean).
Bug root cause worth a task: DrawRegistrationCanvas / DrawPlayBox (D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\Launimator\LauminationBuilderWindow.cs ~1869 and ~2845) draw via GUI.DrawTexture at a scale derived from the frame box with no GUI.BeginClip(rect), so any sprite larger than the 220px stage paints over the elements below the IMGUIContainer. Reproduced on ProtoGuy (56px sheet) and Saint Dragon (57x63 cells).
ZuiAudit (ExpandAll+Audit, windows open at real size): Browser 0/foldedSkipped 0, Catalog 0/0, Aseprite 0/0, Builder 0 findings but foldedSkipped=1 after ExpandAll (not authoritative).
Other code facts used: LauminaryBrowserWindow.cs:32/34 hard-code _newName="Hero" and _newAnimName="Idle"; SpriteCatalog has 0 instances in the project and one consumer (D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\AssetKit\LaubraryAssetWindow.cs); SpriteCatalogWindow.Slice rewrites the source texture importer; Z.EnumDropdown used for AnimZone.behavior (LauminationBuilderWindow.Zones.cs:66); two GenericMenu, one PopupWindow palette, 7 DisplayDialog calls in the Browser.
Skipped: NamePromptWindow uses ShowModalUtility, so it was not opened from the automated session.
